_comment: Per-subject curation for the Blackwood Archer (Tupi) unit-analysis video. Cost is corrected data-drivenly (pop_space 0.5 -> batch 2 -> per-unit cost halved) in build_v2_categorization._batch. ingame_outcome + showcase_override reflect the in-game (golden rig, gRPC) recordings.
_ingame_note: V2 said Blackwood BEATS both elephants (unexpected_win); in-game 3 War Elephants wiped 21 Blackwoods (all 3 survived, 728hp) and 4 Battle Elephants likewise (2 survived) — the trample + huge-HP blind spot, so they move to expected_loss. V2 said Blackwood LOSES to Chu Ko Nu (expected_loss); in-game 21 Blackwoods out-massed 12 Chu Ko Nu and won (9u left) — the single-column sim under-counts Blackwood's numbers, so it moves to expected_win. The generic-cavalry unexpected-wins all HELD (Centurion 8u, Cataphract 21u left; Konnik also won 7u but its dismounts trip the gRPC sanity gate into a slow OCR fallback, so the showcase uses Elite Boyar instead).
_showcase_note: Controlled showcase over the recorded set (12 gRPC-verified fights). Expected Wins: Blackwood's mass shreds ranged (+ out-masses Chu Ko Nu). Unexpected Wins: cheap archers swarm heavy cavalry. Expected Counters: anti-archer Skirmisher/Genitour + the two trampling elephants. Unexpected Counter: Karambit (fast infantry that reaches the line).
